name: Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite
storyline:
● Chapter Spider
In 2009, Ben, a high-ranking executive of the Hong Kong triad The Red Flower Society, was found murdered in Thailand. Yeung Kwun, the head of the society, commissions Yvet to investigate the case. Yvet, a former assassin who escaped the organization The Web and is now under the society's protection, heads to Thailand. There, Ramrowan, the leader of the syndicate Newmoon, is wanted as the primary suspect in Ben's murder. Being an old acquaintance of Ramrowan, Yvet takes action to clear his name and uncover the truth.

● Chapter Cuckoo
In 2009, Jade, an operative for North Korea’s Ministry of State Security, was in Thailand tracking the whereabouts of defectors. She discovers that her targets are being transported by a broker from Hong Kong and begins tailing him, only to witness his assassination right before her eyes. Jade joins forces with her former subordinate Yooyi—who has since defected and now works as a Kathoey in Thailand's red-light district—to pursue the broker's missing mobile phone, which holds the key to the conspiracy.
summary: The latest in the “Red Spider” series of Hong Kong noir visual novel with full japanese voice acting, “Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite” is now available with all-new graphics. The hard-boiled story of two female protagonists is set in Thailand in 2009. Play time: 2-4 hours
